from fixtures import Fixture
import catalog as reg


def test_late_registration():
    reg.reset()
    reg.register(Fixture("k1", 5))
    assert len(reg.find("k1")) == 1
    reg.register(Fixture("k1", 7))
    assert len(reg.find("k1")) == 2


def test_register_then_find():
    reg.reset()
    reg.register(Fixture("k1", 5))
    reg.register(Fixture("k2", 6))
    assert [x.goals for x in reg.find("k2")] == [6]
repo.ISSUE.md: A fixture registered after the first find() never shows up in find(). Registering everything before the first find() works.
